MarketData.Collect_Comment: Schedules the collection jobs on this node in Iran time (see MarketJobScheduler). Enable it on the nodes that collect.
MarketData.DataRoot_Comment: Raw response cache (write-once) and market.duckdb. The BOORS_DATA environment variable overrides it.
MarketData.Node_Comment: Name recorded on every raw response (e.g. iran-1, eu-1). Empty means the machine name; BOORS_NODE overrides it.

MarketApi.Offline_Comment: true: reads never call a source (shareholders are served from the store only).

Node.OperatorToken_Comment: Bearer token required by RunJob and Sync. Empty = open. The BOORS_OPERATOR_TOKEN environment variable overrides it.
